environment.description: Celery worker deployed in a bubblewrap (bwrap) sandbox with filesystem namespace isolation. The process root is pivoted to /opt/worker-chroot which contains only the Python runtime, application code, and CA certificates. The sandbox uses seccomp-bpf profile restricting syscalls to a compute-only subset. Process runs under a dedicated UID (65534) with no supplementary groups. The container's network namespace is configured with a UNIX domain socket proxy (socat-based) that forwards only to the Redis broker — the LDAP server endpoint is not mapped into the network namespace. DNS resolution inside the namespace returns NXDOMAIN for all internal hostnames as /etc/resolv.conf points to a stub resolver that only resolves the broker hostname. The chroot directory contains no sensitive files, credentials, or LDAP configuration beyond what is baked into environment variables at build time (which reference the unreachable LDAP host).

config.filesystem: read-only bind mounts: /opt/worker-chroot/{lib,app,cacerts}; tmpfs for /tmp; no /etc/passwd, no /etc/ldap.conf
config.network_namespace: isolated netns with only a UNIX socket at /run/broker.sock proxied to redis://broker:6379 via host-side socat; no AF_INET/AF_INET6 sockets permitted by seccomp
config.dns: /etc/resolv.conf -> 127.0.0.1 stub that returns NXDOMAIN for all queries
